note: Checks run only with R71_PHASE2_RUN=staging; missing prerequisites are INCOMPLETE and never PASS.

checks.name: test_r71_i01_staging_api_health
checks.criterion: Staging API health endpoint responds with documented JSON.

checks.name: test_r71_i02_staging_private_bundle_rejects_anonymous
checks.criterion: Protected canonical bundle request without credentials returns HTTP 401.

checks.name: test_r71_i03_staging_authenticated_api_pagination
checks.criterion: Authenticated, bounded canonical JSON request responds with valid pagination metadata and no collected_by field.

checks.name: test_r71_i04_staging_api_count_and_bounded_csv
checks.criterion: Count endpoint and bounded CSV export function using an authenticated request.

checks.name: test_r71_i05_postgres_readonly_schema_and_count
checks.criterion: Connect to explicitly approved staging database in read-only transaction and find required canonical tables.

checks.name: test_r71_i06_postgres_matches_api_sample_count
checks.criterion: Staging API sample count equals PostgreSQL sample count, without writing application tables.

checks.name: test_r71_i07_keycloak_discovery_and_jwks
checks.criterion: Staging issuer discovery and JWKS endpoints are reachable and internally consistent.

checks.name: test_r71_i08_minio_canonical_snapshot_exists
checks.criterion: Staging object-storage bucket exists and canonical/latest/all.zip has nonzero size (HEAD/stat only).

checks.name: test_r71_i09_local_canonical_bundle_validates
checks.criterion: Actual local canonical bundle passes structural, type and referential-integrity validator.

checks.name: test_r71_i10_zenodo_csvw_dry_run_no_publication
checks.criterion: Real publisher prepares all six resources and file.json from a local bundle with --dry-run, without contacting Zenodo.
